text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important skill is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key skill is object detection, which means finding and locating several objects within the same image. Computer vision has many practical applications in our daily lives. For example, it is used in security cameras to spot intruders and in medical imaging to help doctors find problems. Perhaps the most exciting application is in self-driving cars, which use computer vision to recognise roads, traffic signs, and pedestrians, helping them drive safely.
